sections.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer focused on building web and mobile products and the backend systems that support them. My experience includes customer-facing applications, enterprise platforms, mobile products, AI-enabled workflows and business process automation.

Beyond implementation, I contribute to understanding requirements, planning features, coordinating with other disciplines, making technical decisions and supporting products through testing and deployment.
I enjoy working on practical problems where thoughtful engineering can improve how people learn, work, transact or access services.
sections.editorialNote: Review and personalise this first-person narrative before publication.
